_note: Poonawalla Fincorp fact base, as of 30-Sep-2026 (Q1FY27 basis). Company presentations are standalone; consolidated and standalone are the same business since Grihum (ex-Poonawalla) Housing Finance was sold on 26/27-Jul-2023 (FY26 consolidated total assets ₹60,272 cr vs standalone ₹60,221 cr; PAT ₹541.81 cr in both). Company ratios: credit cost and opex are % of average AUM; ROA is on average total assets; 'NIM' and 'NII' include fees and other income. Our model uses average AUM throughout. Sources keyed in 'sources'.

guidance.aumGrowth: ~35-40% CAGR over the next couple of years (q4ppt p6, q1ppt p6); 'we could be probably a notch better' (MD, q4call)
guidance.aspiration: 5-6x AUM over the next 5 years (q4ppt p11, 'scale phase')
guidance.roa: 3-3.5% ROA: 'in 3 years from the day I joined' (MD, 25-Apr-2025; joined 10-Jun-2024); 'June exit of 2028' (MD, 17-Jul-2026)
guidance.creditCost: 'structurally improving quarter-on-quarter for a couple of quarters' from 2.4% (MD, q1call); no number
guidance.opex: lower opex-to-AUM every March; 10-25bp quarterly swings from branch clustering (q4call, q1call)
guidance.nim: disbursement yields +40bp (Q4FY26) and +50bp (Q1FY27); 'comfortably NIM accretive' despite a small cost-of-funds uptick (q1call)
guidance.goldBranches: ~400 more in FY27, into UP, AP, Telangana, MP (q1call)
guidance.capital: ₹2,500 cr QIP in Apr-2026 makes the company 'comfortable for the next 4 to 5 quarters' (MD, q1call); 12-month enabling approval for ₹5,500 cr taken in Jan-2026 (q3call)
guidance.mix: secured : unsecured guided around 50:50; 53:47 in Jun-2026 (q1call)
guidance.fy24LongTerm: Q4FY24 long-term guidance (previous management): AUM +35-40%, profit +30-35%, GNPA 1.3-1.8%, NNPA 0.5-0.9%, ROA 4-4.5% (q4fy24ppt p20)
